description: FTP and FTPS engine implementation. Uses suppaftp 6.3.0 (MSRV 1.80.1) with its synchronous API wrapped in tokio::task::spawn_blocking, since suppaftp 6.x uses async-std and suppaftp 12.x requires MSRV 1.88 which exceeds our 1.85 MSRV. The sync-in-spawn_blocking pattern is the same approach used by the blocking reqwest client wrapper and is well-established for bridging sync I/O into tokio. FTP and FTPS share a single FtpEngine<R> struct parameterized by a TLS flag. DEPENDS ON: FEAT-001 (EngineKind::Ftp, EngineKind::Ftps must exist).
steps:
2. Create crates/downloader/src/ftp.rs — implement FtpEngine<R>:

   #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   // at module level

   pub struct FtpEngineConfig {
     pub connect_timeout: Duration,      // default 15s
     pub read_timeout: Duration,          // default 30s
     pub passive_mode: bool,              // default true
   }

   pub struct FtpEngine<R> {
     repository: R,
     config: FtpEngineConfig,
   }

   Implement DownloadEngine and ManagedDownloadEngine for FtpEngine<R>.

   In download_managed:
   a. Load DownloadItem from repository; check engine is Ftp or Ftps (EngineMismatch guard).
   b. Parse URL: scheme (ftp vs ftps), host, port (default 21 for ftp, 21 or 990 for ftps), path, username (from URL authority if present — but reject embedded passwords per EmbeddedCredentials rule; username-only in URL is allowed as it's not a secret), path-encoded filename.
   c. Security: reject any path containing ".." components (FtpPathTraversal error).
   d. Determine destination .part path: destination.with_extension("part") pattern from http.rs.
   e. Call spawn_blocking(move || { ... sync FTP code ... }):
      - Create suppaftp::AsyncFtpStream (sync) or FtpStream for plain FTP
      - For FTPS: FtpStream::connect then upgrade to SecureFtpStream via into_secure()
      - Set read_timeout on the underlying TcpStream
      - Login: anonymous ("anonymous", "") if no username, else (username, "") — credential-free for now (proper credential store is Phase 2 enhancement, documented as a known limitation)
      - Set passive mode
      - SIZE command → total_bytes
      - Check for existing .part file to resume: if .part file exists, get its size, issue REST <offset> before RETR
      - RETR path → read stream in 64 KiB chunks
      - After each chunk: check cancellation watch (via a shared AtomicBool set from outside spawn_blocking, since watch::Receiver is not Send across spawn_blocking)
      - Write chunk to .part file
      - Accumulate progress; send back via mpsc channel to the async side
      - On completion: QUIT, rename .part to destination (atomic)
   f. The async wrapper drives progress updates to repository every PROGRESS_PERSIST_INTERVAL (500ms) from the mpsc channel, also checks pause/cancellation.
   g. Bandwidth: after each chunk, call control.bandwidth.acquire(chunk_len, cancellation, pause) on the async side.
   h. Cancellation/pause: use a shared Arc<AtomicBool> pair (cancel_flag, pause_flag) that the async side sets from the watch receivers; the sync FTP loop polls these flags between chunks.
   i. On completion transition to DownloadStatus::Completed via DownloadStateMachine.
   j. On error: transition to DownloadStatus::Failed, persist error.

   Error type additions needed in error.rs (see step 3).

3. In crates/downloader/src/error.rs — add FTP error variants:
   #[error("FTP error: {0}")] FtpError(String),
   #[error("FTP path contains directory traversal sequence")] FtpPathTraversal,
   #[error("FTP authentication requires credentials not stored in URL")] FtpCredentialRequired,
   In persisted_error match: FtpError/FtpPathTraversal/FtpCredentialRequired map to DownloadErrorCode::Engine with descriptive messages.
   Also add: #[error("SFTP error: {0}")] SftpError(String), #[error("Metalink error: {0}")] MetalinkError(String), #[error("Metalink checksum mismatch: algorithm={algorithm} expected={expected} actual={actual}")] MetalinkChecksumMismatch { algorithm: String, expected: String, actual: String } — add all four protocol error variants now so error.rs only needs one edit.

5. In crates/downloader/src/dispatcher.rs — add FtpEngine support:
   a. Add field: ftp: Option<Arc<FtpEngine<R>>>
   b. Add builder: pub fn with_ftp(mut self, engine: Arc<FtpEngine<R>>) -> Self { self.ftp = Some(engine); self }
   c. In selected_engine_for: Ftp and Ftps engine kinds return Ok(source.engine()) directly (no HLS-style probing needed).
   d. In DownloadEngine::download match: arms for Ftp and Ftps routing to self.ftp.
   e. In ManagedDownloadEngine::download_managed match: same.
   f. In supports_active_pause: Ftp | Ftps => true.
   g. In cancel_inactive: Ftp | Ftps => Ok(()) (no background process).

7. In crates/core-services/src/engine_status.rs — add to EngineRuntimeStatus:
   pub ftp: EngineAvailability,
   FTP/FTPS are always-available (pure Rust, no binary dep) so they always report Available { version: "suppaftp/6.3.0" }.

8. In crates/core-services/src/lib.rs — wire FTP engine:
   a. Import FtpEngine from fetchx_downloader.
   b. Add ftp_engine: Arc<FtpEngine<CoreRepository>> to EngineRuntime struct.
   c. In initialize_with_ytdlp_runner: unconditionally construct Arc::new(FtpEngine::new(repository.clone(), config.ftp.into())) and call dispatcher.with_ftp(Arc::clone(&ftp_engine)).
   d. Update EngineRuntimeStatus construction to include ftp: EngineAvailability::Available { version: "suppaftp/6.3.0".to_owned() }.
   e. Update is_available match to add EngineKind::Ftp | EngineKind::Ftps => true.

9. In crates/queue/src/manager.rs — update RuntimeResourceManager::new (the slice/loop that builds engine_bandwidth map for EngineBandwidthLimits):
   Add EngineKind::Ftp and EngineKind::Ftps (sharing ftp_bytes_per_second) and EngineKind::Metalink to the list. Find the spot by searching for the existing (EngineKind::DirectHttp, ...) tuple pattern and add the new engines following the same pattern.

10. In crates/cli/src/commands/add.rs — update parse_engine:
   "ftp" => Ok(EngineKind::Ftp),
   "ftps" => Ok(EngineKind::Ftps),
   Update the error message to list the new engines.
   Update resolve_engine: if the URL starts with "ftp://" and no --engine flag, return Ok(EngineKind::Ftp); if "ftps://", return Ok(EngineKind::Ftps). Update the test magnet_defaults_to_aria2 to also assert ftp:// scheme resolves to Ftp.
12. Create crates/downloader/tests/fixtures/ directory and add a placeholder README.md explaining it contains static test fixtures for Metalink XML and HLS playlists.

13. Write tests in crates/downloader/src/ftp.rs (or a separate tests module):
   - test_ftp_url_parsing: parses ftp://user@host:2121/path/to/file.bin correctly, rejects path traversal
   - test_ftp_scheme_mismatch: DownloadSource::new("ftp://host/f", EngineKind::DirectHttp) returns SchemeMismatch
   - test_ftp_engine_mismatch_guard: if item has engine DirectHttp but FtpEngine::download is called, returns EngineMismatch
   - LOCAL INTEGRATION TEST (marked with #[ignore] and a doc comment "requires local FTP server"): full FTP download against a local test server built with tokio TcpListener that speaks minimal FTP (USER, PASS, PASV, SIZE, REST, RETR, QUIT)
   The minimal in-process FTP server should live in crates/downloader/src/tests.rs alongside existing HTTP helpers — add start_ftp_server(file_content: Vec<u8>) -> (SocketAddr, JoinHandle<()>) following the existing start_server pattern.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p fetchx-downloader passes — FTP URL parsing, scheme-mismatch, EngineMismatch guard tests all pass
cargo test -p fetchx-core-services passes — EngineRuntime initializes with FTP available
suppaftp 6.3.0 is in Cargo.lock (verify with cargo tree -p fetchx-downloader | grep suppaftp)
findings: suppaftp 6.3.0 uses sync API (not async). sync FTP work is bridged via tokio::task::spawn_blocking. FTPS uses RustlsFtpStream::connect_with_stream + into_secure(RustlsConnector) with webpki-roots for certificate verification. Path traversal detection is performed on raw URL string before parsing to prevent normalization bypass. `unsupported_schemes_and_embedded_credentials_are_rejected` test updated: ftp:// URLs now fail DownloadSource::new with SchemeMismatch (FEAT-001) before they reach the HTTP engine, so that leg of the test was removed. All 185 tests pass, 1 ignored (integration test requiring a live FTP server). Clippy clean. suppaftp 6.3.0 confirmed in Cargo.lock.
